values.note: Transient sites need 3 nights in July and August and on holidays. No more than 30 days in any 60-day period, then the unit must leave the facility. Seasonal sites (sold out for 2026) are offered to the previous season's campers first.

booking.source: https://onoville.com/campground-and-dock-rules-and-regulations ('Transient camp sites in July and August, along with Holidays, have to be booked at a 3 night minimum'; 'Camping ... at one or more campsites for a period longer than thirty (30) days during any sixty (60) consecutive day period is prohibited') + https://onoville.com/docks-campsites ('transient campsites can only be reserved for a maximum of 30 days within a 60 day period'; 'All season sites are now SOLD OUT'; 'Information goes out to 2026 season campers November 2nd, 2026 for the 2027 season'), read 2026-10-21

fees.source: https://onoville.com/season-fees (Camping: '$35.00 Day, $200.00 Week ( Holidays and the months of July and August must be 3 night minimum ), $2,100.00 Season (Primary camping unit, being either a single tent, tow behind, 5th wheel, or motorhome)'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://onoville.com/docks-campsites ('2026 SEASON DATES are May 1st to October 12th'; 'These dates are subject to change based on water level'), read 2026-10-21

summary: County pages confirm $35/day ($200/week, $2,100 season), the 3-night July-August/holiday minimum, and the 2026 season May 1 - Oct 12 (water-level dependent); NEW: 30-in-60-day maximum. No residency limit anywhere (one price, online booking for all). Hookups and facilities not stated on the county pages (left derived; the rules allow portable holding tanks up to 30 gallons, which suggests no sewer at the sites). Note left as is.
flags: Mostly seasonal (criteria check): the note says about two-thirds of the sites are seasonal; the county page says 2026 season sites are sold out and offered to returning campers first, while transient sites book online at a posted daily rate.
